claims: Alexia Jayy was crowned the winner of The Voice Season 29 (Spring 2026) on April 14, 2026.
Alexia Jayy was mentored by coach Adam Levine.
Alexia Jayy won the "Battle of Champions" finale.
The win marks Adam Levine's fourth victory on The Voice.
Lucas West and Mikenley Brown were also in the top four.
Alexia Jayy was on Team Adam.
Liv Ciara was on Team Kelly.
Lucas West was on Team Legend.
Mikenley Brown was on Team Kelly.
Alexia Jayy's winner's single "Rent Free" was scheduled for release on April 15, 2026.
"Rent Free" was produced by Grammy winners Jack Splash and Jim Jonsin.
Alexia Jayy performed Aretha Franklin's "I Never Loved a Man (The Way I Love You)" in the finale.
Alexia Jayy covered Adele in the finale.
